beats.text: Power cut. 8 PM. No phones. No Wi-Fi.
Ammamma lit a candle and said, "Sit. I'll tell you a story."
A king. A clever minister. A moon that followed a boy home.
The lights came back at 10. Nobody moved.
Best night of the year. And it cost nothing.

end.text: Which story did your grandparents tell you?
